Method of Attack: Forces a Windows machine, including a Windows domain controller, to authenticate against a malicious NTLM relay server using the Microsoft Encrypting File System Remote Protocol (EFSRPC)
Relays authentication request to a targeted domain's Active Directory Certificate Services via HTTP to obtain a Kerberos ticket-granting ticket (TGT) and assume domain controller identity
Can be used for NTLMv1 downgrade and relaying machine account on computers where the machine account is local admin
Attack Vector: Remote unauthenticated access via MS-EFSRPC API
Indicators of Compromise: HTTP relay to Active Directory Certificate Services
